integrity: Self-contained proof, standalone Python standard-library census, internally verified file hashes; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: The structural criterion applies to eight-vertex trees; counts exhaustively verified through eight; the all-order path formula is proved. Full text of a closely related 2022/2023 online-learning paper was not available, and independent priority validation remains outstanding.
title: The first entropy deficit for online shattering of convex cuts in finite trees
